seo_title: Waipu, Northland New Zealand — Things to Do, Eat, Stay & Explore
seo_description: Promote Waipu is a non-profit community group promoting the beautiful coastal town of Waipu, Northland, New Zealand. Discover events, local businesses, beaches and more.
hero_tagline: 90 minutes north of Auckland · Stunning beaches · Rich Scottish heritage · Community heart
discover_lead: Just 90 minutes north of Auckland and 30 minutes south of Whangarei, Waipu sits on one of the most stunning coastlines in New Zealand.
discover_body: With its friendly community, iconic beaches, award-winning food and rich Scottish heritage, Waipu is one of Northland's best kept secrets. Home to the UNESCO-listed Waipu Museum, the famous glow worm caves, and spectacular clifftop walking tracks.
cta_body: Promote Waipu is a non-profit community group. All proceeds from membership go directly back into the Waipu community. Get your business listed — basic listings are free.
